text: Which whole-mesh figures change when d4Mesh has an odd side and is one connected lattice?
description:
OP-07: rerun the even-sided mesh results on odd sides.

Known: an even-sided d4Mesh is two disconnected lattices.

Unknown: which reported figures depend on it.

Why it matters: a whole-mesh count on two components is a two-component figure.

Scope: a mechanical pass.

Skills: TypeScript.

Where to start: code/tool/mesh.ts, the PARITY note on d4Mesh.

The claims it would move: R-FND-0001.

Evidence named: d4-mesh-parity, roadmap item 0017.
